title: santalum haleakalae var. lanaiense
intro: Santalum haleakalae var. lanaiense, commonly known as Hawaiian sandalwood or Lanai sandalwood, is a rare and endangered species of sandalwood tree native to Hawaii. This plant is prized for its fragrant wood and has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Santalum haleakalae var. lanaiense include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including santalols and santalic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
